scope: One bounded development preflight. Roof preflight admits tilted roof poses at initial selection using the existing post-side rule on two earlier failures at both timesteps. Front preflight separately tests a slow front-to-back transfer (the existing inverted transfer) on one near-floor start and three standing releases at both timesteps. Full 24 s continuous native dynamics, original standing gate and motor guards. These are development/regression cases, not fresh evaluation, new learning or hardware qualification.
